LESSON: LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
Strand: Citizenship 1.2 Community Needs (9 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand the lea
Topic 1.3: Leadership Development
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Leadership Development, part of Citizenship 1.2 Community Needs (9 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand the lea in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING.

Key inquiry question: How can one become an effective leader?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. carry out research using digital devices or print media on the attributes and skills of a good leader while observing online safety and present the findings in class. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,

2. read case studies or watch brief documentaries of successful local and world leaders who applied different leadership styles and their achievements (transformative, democratic, situational, servant). Learners

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. carry out research using digital devices or print media on the attributes and skills of a good leader while observing online safety and present the findings in class. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,
2. read case studies or watch brief documentaries of successful local and world leaders who applied different leadership styles and their achievements (transformative, democratic, situational, servant). Learners

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Leadership Development together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy as the learner shows a concerted attention to detail while developing the simple CSL guidelines to

govern CSL activities.

● Learning to Learn as the learner carries out research on attributes and skills of a good leader and present in class.

Values:
Integrity is enhanced as learners adhere to laid down procedures in the guidelines as they elect leaders for different

roles for their CSL group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Good governance is promoted as learners develop attributes of good governance as they elect leaders for roles in their

CSL activities.
